slides.body: In Jyotish, Rahu is a shadow planet linked to craving, obsession and the pull of the new. It amplifies wanting more, faster.
Under a strong Rahu theme, the fear of missing out can feel urgent. Hype, trends and crowds start to look like opportunity.
FOMO is a known bias: people buy near the peak because everyone else is. Rahu is a symbolic lens for that same pull.

points: Pause 48 hours before any hype-driven decision
Write down the reason before you act
Cap speculative money at a level you can lose
Talk to a licensed advisor for real decisions

slides.body: This is not a prediction or a tip. It is a mirror for your own habits. Awareness of the urge is the real skill.
No yoga guarantees wealth, and no planet predicts a market. Chart tendencies are not financial advice.
